@waterheart95  maybe you don't get it how GPU decoding works on Desktop Browser in general. Make sure Hardware acceleration is enabled.

When you use GTX 750 Ti , try to watch Music video using any Browser, preferably the one with high view counts. And then on the video, show "Stats for Nerds" . And then just open up Task Manager and see it for yourself that GTX 750 Ti is maxing out. You will see AV1 in there.
